description: This Java class defines a scheduled task (AutoRetireUsersTask) within the OpenMRS platform that automatically retires users after a specified period of inactivity. It retrieves configuration from global properties, computes inactivity based on last login or account creation date, and performs user retirement accordingly.

classes.name: AutoRetireUsersTask
classes.description: A scheduled task that retires users who have been inactive beyond a configured threshold.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method for the scheduled task, triggers user retirement process.

methods.name: getUsersToRetire
methods.description: Retrieves and filters list of users eligible for retirement based on inactivity.

methods.name: userInactivityExceedsDaysToRetire
methods.description: Checks whether a user's inactivity exceeds the specified retirement threshold.
